run it, or what to expect. The goal is a minimal `README.md` that describes the

/workspace/
└── index.js        (22 bytes)

```js
console.log('tally');
```

scripts), no git repo, no `.gitignore`, no dependencies, no tests, no other source
files, and no existing docs. Despite the word "tally", the program counts nothing —
it prints a string and exits.

```markdown
# rc-fixture-bqxRTM

A minimal single-file Node.js script with no dependencies or build step.
Running `node index.js` prints `tally` to stdout and exits.
